title: The Circles index is shelves by who runs them: near you, starters, gathering, Frequency, community, then business (LIVE-1020)

source.ref: Owner design changes list 2026-10-19, items 25 and 26; Circles full-page screenshot (one flat alphabetical grid).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19. Shelves replace the flat grid when no filter is set: Your Circles, featured Business Spaces strip, Resonant near you, Starter Circles, Where people are gathering, Frequency Circles, Community Circles, Business Circles, with a sticky section index and six-and-Show-more per shelf. Classification is derived in lib/circles/kind.ts (ADR-1843). No migration. The rule for 'Frequency' (unowned and featured or hub-attached) is the one judgment call; it is one function to change.
